Because liability climbs the chain, the anchor register exposes who carries the risk, the summit replay walks each level, and the grove audit publishes the total. A slashed identity's forfeiture propagates up to 6 levels of its sponsorship chain, so the member who vouched for it loses too and so does the member above that.
